messages:
Alex G: Quick sync — pulling together the follow-ups from yesterday's continuity Coda. We surfaced a few recurring routing oddities and two gaps in S3 snapshot cadence. Need owners and timelines so we can fold into the next sprint.
Mira L: I can take the routing investigation. I want to map which region pairs see the flapping. ETA for an initial hypothesis by Tue EOD.
Samir: Thx Mira. Can you also check the autoscale routing weights config? I noticed one pool had stale weights during the last failover.
Mira L: Yup I'll look at weights + LB health-checks. Will post a short runbook note.
Jaspreet: I'll own snapshots and restore runbook updates. Action: verify nightly snapshot success for eu-west and ap-south, and add alert for missed snapshot > 2 cycles. Target: next Wed.
Alex G: Nice. Two more items: 1) cold restore dry-run for eu-west (we only tested warm standby) 2) follow-up on the KV cache invalidation pattern that recurred. Who can do the dry-run?
Samir: I can coordinate the dry-run with infra; need a 2-3 hour window with reduced traffic. Prefer Thu morning.
Jaspreet: For runbook entries I'll add a succinct checklist, e.g.
```
- verify latest snapshot exists
- spin restore VM in isolated VPC
- run `db-consistency-check` against restored instance
- run traffic-shift to warm region at 10% increments
- measure end-to-end latency and token throughput
```
I'll include rollback steps and an ops-contacts table.
Mira L: For KV cache invalidation: noticed pattern where prefix eviction coincides with bursty fanout. I'll instrument with a per-prefix hit-rate metric and add a dashboard panel. Owner: Mira. ETA Fri.
oncall-bot: Reminder: continuity-coda follow-ups due in 72h — please update the action tracker.
Alex G: Summarize owners/timelines in this thread so I can paste to the action tracker: Mira (routing + KV metrics) Tue/Fri; Samir (dry-run coord) Thu; Jaspreet (snapshots + runbook) Wed. Any blockers?
Mira L: Need read access to the eu-west LB configs (request submitted).
Samir: I'll reserve Thu 09:00-12:00 UTC and tag infra.
Jaspreet: Will need a reviewer for the runbook changes — @Alex G can you do a quick pass after I push?
Alex G: Yep I can review within 24h of your PR.
Samir: Quick note — for the dry-run we'll use the isolated test VPC and a snapshot from the latest backup. If snapshots are missing, we abort and escalate.
Jaspreet: I'll add a pre-check step to the runbook to validate snapshot integrity and timestamp.
Alex G: Great. One recurring pattern to call out: most incidents show a small set of correlated symptoms (LB weight drift, missed snapshot, and heavy cold-cache misses). We should add a recurring retro to triage these pattern combos and see if a single mitigation (eg, enforce snapshot retention + LB autosync job) can reduce noise. Propose a 30-min triage next Tue.
Mira L: +1, add to calendar.
Samir: +1
Jaspreet: +1 — will prepare a short doc with proposed mitigation options.
Alex G: OK owners: Mira (routing+metrics) — Tue EOD, Samir (dry-run) — Thu 09:00-12:00 UTC, Jaspreet (snapshots+runbook) — Wed, Alex review within 24h of PR. I'll update the tracker right after this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
